name: Anxiety and worry
passages: Phil 4:6-7
You can tell God, one by one, the things weighing on you now, and ask his peace to guard your heart and mind.
Your Father knows what you need; today you only have to face today’s troubles.
Hand the weight on your heart over to God, because he truly cares for you.

blessings.self: May you bring the worries in your heart to God one by one, with thanksgiving. May the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, guard your heart and your thoughts in Christ Jesus; even before anything changes, may your heart be at rest.
blessings.other: May {name} bring every worry to God one by one, with thanksgiving. May the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, guard {name}’s heart and thoughts in Christ Jesus; even before anything changes, may {name}’s heart be at rest.

blessings.self: May your Father, who knows everything you need, catch the worries you carry about tomorrow. May you seek first his Kingdom and his righteousness, leave tomorrow in his hands, and face only today’s troubles today.
blessings.other: May the Father, who knows everything {name} needs, catch {name}’s worries about tomorrow. May {name} seek first his Kingdom and his righteousness, leave tomorrow in his hands, and face only today’s troubles today.

blessings.self: May the God who cares for you catch every worry you cast on him. May you let go under his mighty hand and stop carrying all the weight alone, because he truly cares for you.
blessings.other: May the God who cares for {name} catch every worry {name} casts on him. May {name} let go under his mighty hand and stop carrying all the weight alone, because he truly cares for {name}.

prayers.self: Father, there is so much I can’t let go of. Thank you for inviting me to pray about everything and to bring my requests to you with thanksgiving. I give you these worries now, one by one. Please guard my heart and my thoughts with your peace that surpasses all understanding. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Father, I bring {name} before you. You know the tension and worry in {name}’s heart. Please help {name} tell you each need, one by one, and guard {name}’s heart and thoughts with your peace that surpasses all understanding. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Father, I often worry about tomorrow and the things I can’t know yet. Thank you that you know everything I need. Help me seek first your Kingdom and your righteousness, give tomorrow to you, and focus only on today’s troubles today. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Father, I pray for {name}. You know everything {name} needs, and you see the worries about tomorrow. Help {name} seek first your Kingdom and your righteousness, and leave tomorrow in your hands. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, I am carrying too much and I can barely hold on. Thank you that I may cast all my worries on you, because you care for me. I choose to let go under your mighty hand. Please take these burdens and give me the strength I need today. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. Thank you for caring for {name} and inviting us to cast all our worries on you. Help {name} let go under your mighty hand, and let {name} know they are not alone. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Fear
passages: When you are afraid, hold on to God’s promise “I am with you,” and ask him to strengthen and uphold you.
You don’t have to pretend you aren’t afraid; even in fear you can still choose to trust God.
God is your light and your stronghold; fear doesn’t have to be the voice that rules you.

blessings.self: May the God who says “Don’t be afraid, for I am with you” hold you fast in your most frightening moments. May he strengthen you, help you, and uphold you with his righteous right hand as you walk the road in front of you, one step at a time.
blessings.other: May the God who says “Don’t be afraid, for I am with you” hold {name} fast in the most frightening moments. May he strengthen {name}, help {name}, and uphold {name} with his righteous right hand, one step at a time.

blessings.self: When you are afraid, may you still choose to trust God. You don’t have to pretend you aren’t afraid; may you hold on to his word, praise him for his word, and slowly find your heart settling.
blessings.other: When {name} is afraid, may {name} still choose to trust God. May {name} not have to pretend, but hold on to his word, praise him for his word, and slowly find a settled heart.

blessings.self: May the Lord be your light, your salvation, and the strength of your life. May his light shine into the places where you are afraid, so that fear is no longer the voice that rules you.
blessings.other: May the Lord be {name}’s light, salvation, and the strength of {name}’s life. May his light shine into the places where {name} is afraid, so that fear no longer rules.

prayers.self: Lord, I’m really scared, and I don’t want to pretend to be strong. Thank you for saying, “Don’t be afraid, for I am with you.” Please strengthen me, help me, and uphold me with your righteous right hand. Walk with me, one step at a time, along the road in front of me. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. You know the fear in {name}’s heart. As you promised, please be with {name}; strengthen and help, uphold {name} with your righteous right hand, and give courage and peace. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: God, when I am afraid, I will put my trust in you. I don’t have to pretend I’m not afraid, but I choose to hold on to your word. Please settle my heart, and let me praise your word even in fear, knowing that those who trust you need not be afraid. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: God, I pray for {name}. When {name} is afraid, help {name} choose to trust you and hold on to your word. Please settle {name}’s heart, and let {name} praise you even in the middle of fear. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, you are my light, my salvation, and the strength of my life. The fear in me is loud; please let your voice be louder. Shine into the places where I am afraid, and let me find courage again in you. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, please be {name}’s light, salvation, and the strength of {name}’s life. Shine into the places where {name} is afraid so fear no longer has control, and let {name} find courage again in you. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Grief and loss
passages: God has not moved away from you in your sorrow; he is right beside you.
You can cry and you can miss them; in the Lord, our grief still carries hope.
One day God himself will wipe away every tear.

blessings.self: May the God who is near to the brokenhearted be beside you right now. You can cry, you can miss them, and you don’t have to hurry to be strong. May he hold your broken heart himself and comfort you in every moment of missing them.
blessings.other: May the God who is near to the brokenhearted be beside {name} right now. May {name} feel free to cry and to miss them, without hurrying to be strong. May he hold {name}’s broken heart himself and comfort {name} in every moment of missing them.

blessings.self: May you grieve fully and miss them fully, yet not like those who have no hope. May the Lord Jesus, who died and rose again, become your hope himself, right there in your tears.
blessings.other: May {name} grieve fully and miss them fully, yet not like those who have no hope. May the Lord Jesus, who died and rose again, become {name}’s hope himself, right there in the tears.

blessings.self: May the God who will dwell with his people walk with you through this sorrow now. May you know that one day he himself will wipe away every tear; death will be no more, nor mourning, nor crying, nor pain.
blessings.other: May the God who will dwell with his people walk with {name} through this sorrow now. May {name} know that one day he himself will wipe away every tear; death will be no more, nor mourning, nor crying, nor pain.

prayers.self: Father, my heart hurts so much, and I miss the one who is gone. Thank you for being near to the brokenhearted and for letting me cry in front of you. Please comfort me, walk with me through every day of missing them, and give me strength for the life ahead. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Father, I bring {name}, who is grieving, before you. Thank you for being near to the brokenhearted. Please come near to {name} right now, comfort that broken heart, and walk with {name} through every day of missing them. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord Jesus, I am so sad and I miss them so much. Thank you for letting me grieve, and for making my grief something that is not without hope. You died and rose again; please be my hope in my tears and walk with me, one day at a time. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord Jesus, I pray for {name}, who is grieving. Walk with {name} as {name} grieves and remembers, and let {name} see, even through tears, the hope your death and resurrection bring. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Father, the pain of losing them is still here, and so are the tears. Thank you for promising that one day you will dwell with us and wipe away every tear yourself. Until that day comes, please walk with me through every moment of missing them. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Father, I bring {name} before you. Thank you for promising to wipe away every tear yourself. Until that day comes, please walk with {name} through every moment of missing them, and use me to walk with {name} too. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Illness and pain
passages: When your body is failing, God is still the strength of your heart.
Though your outer body is weak, God is still renewing you inwardly day by day.
Whatever happens with your illness, God’s grace is enough for you each day.

blessings.self: In the days when your body is weak and your strength fails, may God be the strength of your heart. May you know, even in illness, that he is your portion forever, and may he watch over the medical team caring for you.
blessings.other: In the days when {name}’s body is weak and strength fails, may God be the strength of {name}’s heart. May {name} know, even in illness, that he is {name}’s portion forever, and may he watch over the medical team caring for {name}.

blessings.self: In the days when your outer body is weak, may God renew your inner self day by day. May you see more than the trouble in front of you, and fix your eyes on the hope that is unseen and eternal.
blessings.other: In the days when {name}’s outer body is weak, may God renew {name}’s inner self day by day. May {name} see more than the trouble in front of them, and fix their eyes on the hope that is unseen and eternal.

blessings.self: May the Lord’s grace be enough for you every day. May his power be made perfect in your weakness, so that when you have no strength left, the power of Christ still rests on you.
blessings.other: May the Lord’s grace be enough for {name} every day. May his power be made perfect in {name}’s weakness, so that when {name} has no strength left, the power of Christ still rests on {name}.

prayers.self: Lord, my body feels awful, and my heart is worn out. My flesh and my heart fail, but please be the strength of my heart. Please heal me, give the doctors and nurses wisdom, and let me know even in this illness that you are my portion. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}, who is sick. Please heal {name}’s body, ease the pain, and give the medical team wisdom. When {name}’s body is weak, be the strength of {name}’s heart, and give the family strength and peace. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, my body is growing weaker day by day, and sometimes I really lose heart. Please renew my inner self day by day. Let me see more than the trouble in front of me, and fix my eyes on the eternal hope you have promised. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. In these days of physical weakness, please renew {name}’s inner self day by day so {name} does not lose heart, and help {name} keep their eyes on the eternal hope, even in suffering. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, I feel so weak, like I can’t do anything. Thank you for saying, “My grace is sufficient for you.” Please let your power be made perfect in my weakness, and let me find every day that your grace really is enough. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}, who is sick. Thank you that your grace is sufficient. Let your power be made perfect in {name}’s weakness, and whatever course the illness takes, let {name} know your grace every day. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Weariness and weakness
passages: Jesus invites you, weary and burdened, to come to him and find rest.
God does not grow tired; he gives strength to the weak.
The good shepherd leads you beside still waters and restores your soul.

blessings.self: May the Lord, who invites all who labor and are heavily burdened to come and rest, lift the burden that is too heavy for your shoulders. May you learn from him, who is gentle and humble in heart, take his easy yoke, and find true rest for your soul.
blessings.other: May the Lord, who invites all who labor and are heavily burdened to come and rest, lift the burden that is too heavy for {name}’s shoulders. May {name} learn from him, who is gentle and humble in heart, take his easy yoke, and find true rest.

blessings.self: May the God who does not faint or grow weary give new strength to you in your weakness. As you wait for him, may you renew your strength, mount up with wings like eagles, run and not be weary, walk and not faint.
blessings.other: May the God who does not faint or grow weary give new strength to {name} in weakness. As {name} waits for him, may {name} renew their strength, mount up with wings like eagles, run and not be weary, walk and not faint.

blessings.self: May the Lord be your shepherd, so that even in exhaustion you lack nothing. May he make you lie down in green pastures, lead you beside still waters, and restore your soul.
blessings.other: May the Lord be {name}’s shepherd, so that even in exhaustion {name} lacks nothing. May he make {name} lie down in green pastures, lead {name} beside still waters, and restore {name}’s soul.

prayers.self: Lord Jesus, I’m so tired, and the load is so heavy. Thank you for inviting the weary and burdened to come to you. I’m coming to you now. Please give me rest, and teach me to be like you, gentle and humble in heart, and to take your easy yoke. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord Jesus, I pray for {name}. You see {name}’s labor and heavy burdens. Please draw {name} to you to find rest, lift the burden that is too heavy, and teach {name} your gentle and humble way. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Everlasting God, I have no strength left. Thank you that you do not faint or grow weary, and that you give power to the weak. I want to wait for you. Please renew my strength, so I can run and not be weary, walk and not faint. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Everlasting God, I pray for {name}, who is worn out. Thank you that you give power to the weak. As {name} waits for you, please renew {name}’s strength, so {name} can run and not be weary, walk and not faint. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, you are my shepherd. I’m so tired. Please make me lie down in green pastures and lead me beside still waters. Restore my soul, and guide my next step for your name’s sake. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, please be {name}’s shepherd. {name} is so tired; please lead {name} beside still waters, restore that weary soul, and guide the road ahead. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Loneliness and rejection
passages: God says, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”
Even if the people closest to you leave, God still takes you in.
God has not forgotten you; your name is engraved on the palms of his hands.

blessings.self: May the Lord who says “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you” let you know, in your loneliness, that he has been here all along. May you say with confidence: The Lord is my helper; I will not fear.
blessings.other: May the Lord who says “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you” let {name} know, in loneliness, that he has been here all along. May {name} say with confidence: The Lord is my helper; I will not fear.

blessings.self: When you feel abandoned, may you find that the Lord himself takes you in. Even if the people closest to you have left, may his care become your home, and may he bring you genuine companionship.
blessings.other: When {name} feels abandoned, may {name} find that the Lord himself takes {name} in. Even if the people closest have left, may his care become {name}’s home, and may he bring genuine companionship.

blessings.self: May you know that you have not been forgotten: God has engraved you on the palms of his hands. May he remember you always, be your help at every moment, and bring you genuine companionship.
blessings.other: May {name} know that {name} has not been forgotten: God has engraved {name} on the palms of his hands. May he remember {name} always, be a help at every moment, and bring {name} genuine companionship.

prayers.self: Lord, I feel so alone, like no one really understands me. Thank you for saying, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.” Let me know your presence in my loneliness, so I can say with confidence: The Lord is my helper. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}, who feels lonely. Thank you for promising never to leave or forsake those who are yours. Let {name} know your presence, and bring {name} genuine companionship. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, I feel abandoned by the people closest to me. Thank you for saying that even if my father and mother forsake me, you will take me up. Please take me in yourself, heal my heart, and bring me people I can trust. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. {name} feels abandoned, but you promised to take us up. Please take {name} in yourself, heal that wounded heart, and bring people {name} can trust. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: God, sometimes I feel forgotten by everyone. Thank you for saying you will not forget me, and that you have engraved me on the palms of your hands. Let me truly feel remembered by you, and help me open up to the people around me. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: God, I pray for {name}. Thank you that you never forget those who are yours, and that you engrave them on the palms of your hands. Let {name} truly feel remembered by you, and help {name} open up to the people nearby. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Heartbreak
passages: The pain of a broken heart is real; the God who counts the stars and calls each one by name also sees every one of your tears.
Human love may leave, but God’s loving kindness will not leave you.
There is a time for weeping; in his time, God can turn mourning into dancing.

blessings.self: May the God who heals the broken in heart bind up the wounds on your heart himself. May you know that the God who calls every star by name also remembers your name and every one of your tears.
blessings.other: May the God who heals the broken in heart bind up the wounds on {name}’s heart himself. May {name} know that the God who calls every star by name also remembers {name}’s name and every tear.

blessings.self: As you lose a relationship, may you experience God’s loving kindness that does not leave. Mountains may depart and people may leave, but his covenant of peace still rests on you.
blessings.other: As {name} loses a relationship, may {name} experience God’s loving kindness that does not leave. Mountains may depart and people may leave, but his covenant of peace still rests on {name}.

blessings.self: May God walk with you through the nights of weeping, and in the right time turn your mourning into dancing. May you be clothed with gladness again, and may your heart sing once more.
blessings.other: May God walk with {name} through the nights of weeping, and in the right time turn {name}’s mourning into dancing. May {name} be clothed with gladness again, and may {name}’s heart sing once more.

prayers.self: Lord, my heart hurts so much, and so many memories keep coming back. Thank you that you heal the broken in heart and bind up their wounds. Please heal me yourself, and help me slowly let go, without endlessly blaming myself or the other person. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. The end of this relationship has hurt {name} deeply. Please heal {name}’s broken heart, bind up the wounds, and let {name} know you remember every one of {name}’s tears. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Father, I thought this love would always be there, and now I feel left behind. Thank you for saying your loving kindness will not depart from me. Help me find my footing again in your unchanging love, and know that I am still loved. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Father, I pray for {name}. As this relationship ends, let {name} experience your loving kindness that does not leave, find solid ground again in your covenant of peace, and know that {name} is still loved. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: God, I’m still crying, and I don’t know how long it will take to feel better. Please walk with me through these days, and in your time turn my mourning into dancing, so that I can know joy again and praise you once more. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: God, I pray for {name}. Please walk with {name} through these painful days, and in your time turn {name}’s mourning into dancing, so {name} can know joy again. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Failure and setbacks
passages: You stumbled this time, but God’s hand is still holding you up.
Mic 7:8
When you sit in darkness, the Lord is still your light.
God’s mercies are new every morning; tomorrow is still a new beginning.

blessings.self: May the Lord, who establishes your steps, hold you up with his hand where you have stumbled. This fall is not the whole of who you are; may he lift you up and lead you into your next step.
blessings.other: May the Lord, who establishes our steps, hold {name} up with his hand where {name} has stumbled. This fall is not the whole of who {name} is; may he lift {name} up and lead into the next step.

blessings.self: Though you have fallen, may you rise; though you sit in darkness, may the Lord be your light. May his light show you the path for your next step.
blessings.other: Though {name} has fallen, may {name} rise; though {name} sits in darkness, may the Lord be {name}’s light. May his light show {name} the path for the next step.

blessings.self: As you call to mind God’s loving kindness, may hope rise in your heart again. May you find that his mercies are new every morning, and as you wait quietly, may you see the new beginning he has prepared for you.
blessings.other: As {name} calls to mind God’s loving kindness, may hope rise again. May {name} find that his mercies are new every morning, and as {name} waits quietly, may {name} see the new beginning he has prepared.

prayers.self: Lord, I really fell this time, and I feel ashamed. Thank you for saying that though we stumble, we will not fall, because you hold us up with your hand. Please lift me up, establish my steps, and lead me into my next step. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. {name} stumbled this time and is hurting. Please hold {name} up with your hand, lift {name} up, establish {name}’s steps, and don’t let this failure become the whole of who {name} is. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, I have fallen, and it feels like I’m sitting in darkness. But you are my light. Please raise me up again, light the path for my next step, and keep me from being trapped by other people’s opinions and my own self-blame. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. {name} has fallen and seems to be sitting in darkness. Please be {name}’s light, raise {name} up again, and light the path for the next step. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, I’m so disappointed, even in myself. But when I call to mind your loving kindness, I have hope. Thank you that your mercies are new every morning. As I wait quietly, please give me a new beginning. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. Thank you that because of your loving kindness we are not consumed, and your mercies are new every morning. Give {name} hope again, and as {name} waits, let {name} see the new beginning you have prepared. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Guilt and repentance
passages: 1John 1:8-9
Confess honestly; God is faithful, and he will forgive and cleanse.
Ask God to create a clean heart and restore the joy of salvation.
Those who repent no longer have to live under condemnation.

blessings.self: May you face yourself honestly and bring your sins to God. May the faithful and righteous God forgive your sins and cleanse you from all unrighteousness, so you can lift your head again.
blessings.other: May {name} face themselves honestly and bring their sins to God. May the faithful and righteous God forgive {name}’s sins and cleanse {name} from all unrighteousness, so {name} can lift their head again.

blessings.self: May God create a clean heart in you and renew a right spirit within you. May he not cast you away, but restore to you the joy of your salvation and uphold you with a willing spirit.
blessings.other: May God create a clean heart in {name} and renew a right spirit within. May he not cast {name} away, but restore the joy of salvation and uphold {name} with a willing spirit.

blessings.self: May you know that there is no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus. May the Spirit of life set you free, so that you no longer live bound by guilt, but live in his grace.
blessings.other: May {name} know that there is no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus. May the Spirit of life set {name} free, so that {name} no longer lives bound by guilt, but lives in his grace.

prayers.self: God, I did wrong, and I don’t want to make excuses anymore. I honestly confess my sins before you. Thank you that you are faithful and righteous to forgive my sins and cleanse me from all unrighteousness. Please give me courage to make things right, too. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: God, I pray for {name}. Please help {name} face themselves honestly and bring their sins to you. Thank you that you are faithful and righteous to forgive and to cleanse. Please give {name} courage to make things right, too. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: God, create in me a clean heart, and renew a right spirit within me. Don’t throw me from your presence. Restore to me the joy of your salvation, and uphold me with a willing spirit. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: God, I pray for {name}. Please create a clean heart in {name} and renew a right spirit within. Do not cast {name} away; restore the joy of salvation, and uphold {name} with a willing spirit. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord Jesus, guilt often weighs me down so much that I can’t lift my head. Thank you that there is no condemnation for those who are in you. Please set me free by the Spirit of life, so that I no longer live in self-blame, but in your grace. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord Jesus, I pray for {name}. Thank you that there is no condemnation for those who are in you. Please set {name} free by the Spirit of life, no longer living in guilt and self-blame, but in your grace. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Forgiveness and reconciliation
passages: The strength to forgive comes from having first been forgiven by God.
Bear with one another in compassion, kindness, and patience, and let love bind the relationship together.
Forgiveness often has to happen again and again; it is a process.

blessings.self: May the God who forgave you in Christ heal the hurt in your heart himself. May bitterness and anger slowly leave, and kindness and tender compassion slowly grow, so that forgiveness can begin from the place where you were first forgiven.
blessings.other: May the God who forgave {name} in Christ heal the hurt in {name}’s heart himself. May bitterness and anger slowly leave, and kindness and tender compassion slowly grow, so that forgiveness can begin from the place where {name} was first forgiven.

blessings.self: As one chosen and loved by God, may you put on a heart of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience. May the Lord’s love bind you together with the people around you and make bearing with one another possible.
blessings.other: As one chosen and loved by God, may {name} put on a heart of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience. May the Lord’s love bind {name} together with the people nearby and make bearing with one another possible.

blessings.self: May the Lord, who forgave you an enormous debt, walk with you on the road of forgiveness again and again. May he give you wisdom to know which relationships can be reconciled and which need time and boundaries.
blessings.other: May the Lord, who forgave {name} an enormous debt, walk with {name} on the road of forgiveness again and again. May he give {name} wisdom to know which relationships can be reconciled and which need time and boundaries.

prayers.self: Father, this relationship has hurt me deeply, and it’s hard to let go. Thank you for forgiving me first in Christ. Please remove the bitterness and anger in my heart, let kindness and compassion slowly grow, and lead me step by step toward forgiveness. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Father, I pray for {name}. You know the hurt in {name}’s heart. Please heal it yourself, remove the bitterness and anger, and let kindness and compassion slowly grow in {name}, rooted in your love that forgave us first. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, getting along with the people around me is hard. Thank you for choosing me and loving me. Help me put on a heart of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience, learn to bear with others, and let your love bind our relationships together. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name} and the people around {name}. Help {name} put on a heart of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience, learn to bear with others, and let your love mend their relationships. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, I thought I had forgiven, but the pain keeps coming back. Thank you for first forgiving me an enormous debt. Please walk with me as I choose to forgive again and again; and if boundaries are needed, please give me wisdom. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. Forgiveness often has to happen again and again. Please walk with {name} on this road of forgiveness, heal the pain that keeps coming back, and if boundaries are needed, give {name} wisdom. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Healing family relationships
passages: Luke 15:20
A turning point in a relationship may begin with one willing step closer; the Father’s heart is always open to those coming home.
You can’t control how your family responds, but as far as it depends on you, you can do your best to live at peace.
Past hurts in a family are real, but God can bring good change out of them, so that people can comfort one another with kind words.

blessings.self: May the Father’s love, which runs to meet us, embrace you first. May the coldness and distance in your family begin to change with one small step closer, so that going home becomes a warm thing again.
blessings.other: May the Father’s love, which runs to meet us, embrace {name} first. May the coldness and distance in {name}’s family begin to change with one small step closer, so that going home becomes a warm thing again.

blessings.self: May God give you strength not to repay evil for evil, and as far as it depends on you, to pursue peace. May you leave the other person’s response to God, and not carry a burden that isn’t yours.
blessings.other: May God give {name} strength not to repay evil for evil, and as far as it depends on {name}, to pursue peace. May {name} leave the other person’s response to God, and not carry a burden that isn’t {name}’s.

blessings.self: May the God who worked in Joseph’s family also work in yours. May past hurts no longer be the end of the story; may God bring good change out of them, so that you can comfort one another with kind words.
blessings.other: May the God who worked in Joseph’s family also work in {name}’s family. May past hurts no longer be the end of the story; may God bring good change out of them, so that {name} and the family can comfort one another with kind words.

prayers.self: Father, there is such a deep distance between me and my family, and I don’t know how to begin. Thank you for being like that father who saw his son from far away and ran to him. Please give me courage to take the first step, and soften all our hearts toward each other. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Father, I pray for {name}’s relationship with their family. Please embrace {name} with your love that runs to meet us, give {name} courage to take the first step, and soften the hearts of {name} and the family toward each other. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, my family’s words sometimes hurt me so much that I want to answer the same way. Help me not repay evil for evil, do what I can to live at peace, and give you what I can’t do. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. Please guard {name}’s heart in these family relationships, help {name} not repay evil for evil, do what {name} can to live at peace, and give you what {name} can’t do. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: God, you know the hurts from my family’s past. I believe you can turn evil into good. Please heal the relationships in our family, and let us one day comfort one another with kind words. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: God, you know the hurts from {name}’s family’s past. Please heal the relationships between {name} and the family, turn evil into good, and let them one day comfort one another with kind words. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Anger and words
passages: Stop and listen first, then speak, and let your anger pass slowly.
Anger is allowed, but don’t let it last overnight and turn into greater harm.
Prov 15:1
A gentle answer can often cool a conflict.

blessings.self: May the God of peace help you pause when your anger rises. May you be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger, so that your words leave no wounds behind.
blessings.other: May the God of peace help {name} pause when anger rises. May {name} be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger, so that {name}’s words leave no wounds behind.

blessings.self: May you be angry and yet not sin. May God help you not let the sun go down on your anger, but bring it to him before the night, and give no place to the enemy to damage your relationships.
blessings.other: May {name} be angry and yet not sin. May God help {name} not let the sun go down on anger, but bring it to him before the night, and give no place to the enemy to damage {name}’s relationships.

blessings.self: May God put gentle words in your mouth. May one gentle answer from you turn away wrath, cool the conflict, and mend the relationships you treasure.
blessings.other: May God put gentle words in {name}’s mouth. May one gentle answer from {name} turn away wrath, cool the conflict, and mend the relationships {name} treasures.

prayers.self: Lord, I’ve been getting angry easily lately, and my words have hurt people. Help me be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger; help me pause before I speak, so that my words no longer leave wounds. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. When anger rises, help {name} pause, be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger, and speak words full of kindness. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, I’m really angry right now, and I don’t want this anger to become sin. Help me not let the sun go down on my anger; let me bring it to you before today ends, and give me courage to deal with what needs dealing with. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. Help {name} be angry and yet not sin, not let the sun go down on anger, bring the anger to you, and have the courage to deal with what needs dealing with. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, the conflict between us keeps getting worse. Please put gentle words in my mouth, so that my gentle answer turns away wrath. Keep me from harsh words, and mend the relationship between us. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. Please put gentle words in {name}’s mouth, let {name}’s gentle answer turn away wrath, and mend the relationship between {name} and the other person. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Marriage and home
passages: Love is more than a feeling; it is patience, kindness, and bearing with each other, chosen every day.
Eccl 4:9-12
Two together, with God as the third strand, are not easily broken.
A home needs to be built by God, not by our own strength alone.

blessings.self: May God’s love dwell in your home. May you be patient and kind with one another, keep no record of wrongs, and in your everyday choices bear all things, believe all things, hope all things, and endure all things.
blessings.other: May God’s love dwell in {name}’s home. May {name} and the family be patient and kind with one another, keep no record of wrongs, and in their everyday choices bear all things, believe all things, hope all things, and endure all things.

blessings.self: When one of you falls, may the other lift you up; when you are cold, may you warm each other. May God be the third strand between you, so that your relationship is not easily broken.
blessings.other: When one of them falls, may {name} and the family lift each other up; when they are cold, may they warm each other. May God be the third strand between them, so that their relationship is not easily broken.

blessings.self: May the Lord himself build your house and watch over it. May you not labor only by your own strength, but sleep in peace under his care.
blessings.other: May the Lord himself build {name}’s house and watch over it. May {name} and the family not labor only by their own strength, but sleep in peace under his care.

prayers.self: Father, our home needs your love. Teach us to be patient and kind, and to keep no record of wrongs. In the small things of every day, help us bear all things, believe all things, hope all things, and endure all things. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Father, I pray for {name}’s home. Teach {name} and the family to be patient and kind and to keep no record of wrongs, and in the small things of every day, to learn to bear all things and hope all things. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Father, thank you that we are not alone. Help us lift each other up when we fall, and warm each other when things grow cold. Please be the third strand between us, so our relationship is not easily broken. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Father, I pray for {name}’s home. Help {name} and the family lift each other up when they fall and warm each other when things grow cold, and please be the third strand between them. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, we work so hard to hold this family together, and we’re often worn out. Please build our home yourself and watch over it, so we don’t rely only on our own strength, but rest in peace under your care. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}’s home. Please build this home and watch over it yourself, so that {name} and the family don’t labor only by their own strength, but rest in peace under your care. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Seeking love and marriage
passages: Prov 4:23
When you long for a relationship, take good care of your own heart first: value character, and notice what draws you.
Song 2:7
You don’t need to rush love; it can mature slowly in God’s time.
God will not withhold what is truly good from you; you can trust him and wait and choose with integrity.

blessings.self: May God guard your heart, so that as you hope for a relationship you still value character and understand what draws you. May your heart be filled with God’s word, so that the springs of your life flow from a healthy heart.
blessings.other: May God guard {name}’s heart, so that as {name} hopes for a relationship {name} still values character and understands what draws them. May {name}’s heart be filled with God’s word, so that the springs of {name}’s life flow from a healthy heart.

blessings.self: May you not be rushed by age, by what others think, or by comparison, but rest as love matures slowly in God’s time. In the days of waiting, may you also enjoy the joy of being loved by God.
blessings.other: May {name} not be rushed by age, by what others think, or by comparison, but rest as love matures slowly in God’s time. In the days of waiting, may {name} also enjoy the joy of being loved by God.

blessings.self: May the God who is your sun and shield light up your choices and protect your heart. May you walk with integrity and trust him, because he will not withhold what is truly good from you.
blessings.other: May the God who is {name}’s sun and shield light up {name}’s choices and protect {name}’s heart. May {name} walk with integrity and trust him, because he will not withhold what is truly good from {name}.

prayers.self: Father, I long for a good relationship, and I really want to meet the right person. Please guard my heart; help me value character above looks and passing feelings, and help me understand what I truly need. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Father, I pray for {name}. You know {name}’s longing for love and marriage. Please guard {name}’s heart; help {name} value character above looks and passing feelings, and give clear discernment while getting to know someone and dating. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, seeing the people around me find partners one by one, I sometimes feel anxious and doubt myself. Help me not to force or rush things, to leave the timing of love in your hands, and to live a full life while I wait. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. Please take away the anxiety and comparison in {name}’s heart; help {name} not to force or rush things, to leave the timing of love in your hands, and to live a full life in the days of waiting. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord God, you are my sun and shield. I want to trust you, and to get to know people and make choices with integrity. Please lead me to someone after your own heart, and prepare me to be a good partner too. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord God, you are {name}’s sun and shield. Please light {name}’s path, lead {name} to someone after your own heart, and prepare {name} to be a good partner too. May {name} be blessed in trusting you. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Raising children
passages: Deut 6:5-7
Parenting begins with loving God yourself; faith can be passed on in everyday conversations at meals, on walks, and at bedtime.
Eph 6:4
When you discipline, be careful not to provoke your child; raise them with the Lord’s instruction and gentle boundaries.
When looking after children wears you out, God is like a shepherd who gently leads you, the caregiver, too.

blessings.self: May you be filled with God’s love first, and then carry that love home. At meals, on walks, at bedtime, in ordinary moments, may you talk about God naturally with your children, so faith takes root in everyday life.
blessings.other: May {name} be filled with God’s love first, and then carry that love home. At meals, on walks, at bedtime, in ordinary moments, may {name} talk about God naturally with the children, so faith takes root in everyday life.

blessings.self: May God give you wisdom and gentleness, so that your discipline has clear boundaries but no anger or shame. May your children grow up in the Lord’s instruction and come to know the Father’s love through you.
blessings.other: May God give {name} wisdom and gentleness, so that {name}’s discipline has clear boundaries but no anger or shame. May {name}’s children grow up in the Lord’s instruction and come to know the Father’s love through {name}.

blessings.self: May the good shepherd gently carry your children, and slowly lead you, worn out as you are. May you know you are not raising your children alone; God himself works alongside you.
blessings.other: May the good shepherd gently carry {name}’s children, and slowly lead {name}, worn out as {name} is. May {name} know that {name} is not raising the children alone; God himself works alongside {name}.

prayers.self: Father, thank you for entrusting my children to me. I often feel I’m not good enough and don’t know how to teach them. Help me first love you with all my heart, and help me pass your word on to my children naturally in everyday life. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Father, I pray for {name} and {name}’s children. Let {name} be satisfied in your love, and help {name} pass your word on to the children naturally in everyday life. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, I admit that sometimes I’m too impatient and too harsh with my children, and I’ve said things that hurt them. Please forgive me, and give me gentleness and wisdom to discipline without anger and raise my children in your instruction. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. Raising children isn’t easy. Please give {name} gentleness and wisdom to set clear boundaries without anger, and let the children grow up in your instruction. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Good shepherd, I’m so tired. Thank you that you not only carry the lambs, but also gently lead those who care for them. Please renew my strength, watch over my children, and let me know I’m not raising them alone. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Good shepherd, I bring {name} before you. Caring for the children has left {name} exhausted. Please lead {name} gently, renew {name}’s strength, and watch over {name}’s children yourself. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Work and finances
passages: Trust God, do the work in front of you faithfully, and commit your way to him.
Whether in plenty or in need, through the Lord you can learn contentment and face what comes.
The Lord sees your work; you can offer it to him.

blessings.self: May you trust in the Lord and do good, and feed on his faithfulness. May you commit the path of your work and life to him, find your delight in him, and see him bring it to pass.
blessings.other: May {name} trust in the Lord and do good, and feed on his faithfulness. May {name} commit the path of work and life to him, find delight in him, and see him bring it to pass.

blessings.self: May you learn to be content whether in plenty or in need. May the Lord who strengthens you help you face every situation through him, so you are neither crushed by need nor led astray by plenty.
blessings.other: May {name} learn to be content whether in plenty or in need. May the Lord who strengthens {name} help {name} face every situation through him, neither crushed by need nor led astray by plenty.

blessings.self: May the work of your hands be done as for the Lord. May you know that the Lord sees every bit of your effort, and that the true reward comes from him, whether or not anyone else notices.
blessings.other: May the work of {name}’s hands be done as for the Lord. May {name} know that the Lord sees every bit of {name}’s effort, and that the true reward comes from him, whether or not anyone else notices.

prayers.self: Father, the pressure of work and money makes me anxious. Help me trust you and do good, feed on your faithfulness, and commit the road ahead to you. Please provide for my needs and lead my next step. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Father, I pray for {name}. You know the pressure {name} is under at work and with money. Please provide for {name}’s needs, and help {name} trust you, do good, and commit the way to you. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, I often worry about not having enough, and I envy what others have. Teach me to be content in every situation, and to face each day’s needs through you who strengthen me. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. Whether in plenty or in need, teach {name} contentment and to face each day through the strength you give, and please provide for {name}’s real needs. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, my efforts often go unnoticed, and I feel undervalued. Thank you that you see it all. Help me do whatever I do from the heart, as for you, because the true reward comes from you. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. Thank you that you see every bit of {name}’s effort. Help {name} do whatever {name} does from the heart, as for you, and know your presence at work. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Direction and the future
passages: Prov 3:5-6
Don’t rely only on your own understanding; acknowledge God’s leading at every step.
Jas 1:5
When you lack wisdom, you can ask God with confidence.
God is willing to teach you and show you the way you should go.

blessings.self: May the God who directs our paths lead you at the fork in the road ahead of you. May you trust in him with all your heart, not lean on your own understanding, and acknowledge him in all your ways; he will make your paths straight.
blessings.other: May the God who directs our paths lead {name} at the fork in the road ahead. May {name} trust in him with all their heart, not lean on their own understanding, and acknowledge him in all their ways; he will make {name}’s paths straight.

blessings.self: May the God who gives generously to all without reproach give you abundantly the wisdom you lack. May you ask him with confidence and see clearly in every decision.
blessings.other: May the God who gives generously to all without reproach give {name} abundantly the wisdom {name} lacks. May {name} ask him with confidence and see clearly in every decision.

blessings.self: May God himself instruct you and teach you the way you should go. May you know his eye is on you, leading you step by step on firm and peaceful ground.
blessings.other: May God himself instruct {name} and teach {name} the way to go. May {name} know his eye is on {name}, leading step by step on firm and peaceful ground.

prayers.self: Lord, I’m facing a choice and I don’t know which way to go. I want to trust you with all my heart and not lean on my own understanding. Help me acknowledge you at every step, and direct my path yourself. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}, who is facing a choice. Help {name} trust you with all their heart, not lean on their own understanding, acknowledge you at every step, and please direct {name}’s path yourself. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: God, I lack wisdom and don’t know what to decide. Thank you for saying that anyone who lacks wisdom can ask you, and you will give generously without reproach. I’m asking you now: please give me discernment and a clear mind. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: God, I pray for {name}. Thank you that you give wisdom generously without reproach. Please give {name} discernment and a clear mind to see this decision clearly. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, I don’t know where my next step is. Thank you for promising to instruct me and teach me the way I should go. Please open the doors that should open and close the ones that should close, and give me people I can pray and talk things through with. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. As you have promised, please instruct {name} and show the way to go; open the doors that should open for {name} and close the ones that should close. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Waiting
passages: While you wait, you can take courage and believe you will see God’s goodness.
Waiting quietly for God is itself good.
God hears those who wait patiently and sets their feet on a rock.

blessings.self: In this long wait, may you be strong and let your heart take courage. May you not be swallowed by discouragement, but still believe you will see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.
blessings.other: In this long wait, may {name} be strong and let their heart take courage. May {name} not be swallowed by discouragement, but still believe {name} will see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.

blessings.self: As you wait quietly, may your heart keep seeking God. May the Lord, who is good to those who wait for him, let you see his salvation in his time.
blessings.other: As {name} waits quietly, may {name}’s heart keep seeking God. May the Lord, who is good to those who wait for him, let {name} see his salvation in his time.

blessings.self: May the God who hears our cry hear your patient waiting. May he lift you out of the pit, set your feet on a rock, and put a new song in your mouth.
blessings.other: May the God who hears our cry hear {name}’s patient waiting. May he lift {name} out of the pit, set {name}’s feet on a rock, and put a new song in {name}’s mouth.

prayers.self: Lord, this wait has been so long that I’m close to giving up. Please strengthen my heart and give me courage. Help me keep believing that I will see your goodness in the land of the living. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}, who is waiting. Please strengthen {name}’s heart and give courage, so {name} keeps believing they will see your goodness in the land of the living. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, I don’t know how much longer I have to wait. Teach me to wait for you quietly and keep seeking you in my heart. Thank you that you are good to those who wait for you; please let me see your salvation in your time. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. Teach {name} to wait for you quietly and keep seeking you. Thank you that you are good to those who wait for you; please show your kindness to {name} in your time. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, I have been waiting for you; please hear my cry. Lift me out of the pit, set my feet on a rock, and one day put a new song in my mouth. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. Please hear {name}’s patient waiting and crying out; lift {name} out of the pit, set {name}’s feet on a rock, and put a new song in {name}’s mouth. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Suffering and trials
passages: God is your very present help in trouble.
Pressed and perplexed, but God will not let you be crushed.
When you can’t find the words, the Spirit himself intercedes for you; God is still in control.

blessings.self: May God be your refuge and strength, a very present help in all the turmoil. When everything around you is shaking, may your heart not be afraid, because he is with you.
blessings.other: May God be {name}’s refuge and strength, a very present help in all the turmoil. When everything around is shaking, may {name}’s heart not be afraid, because he is with {name}.

blessings.self: Though you are pressed on every side, may you not be crushed; though perplexed, may you not despair. When you are struck down, may God hold you up and not let you be destroyed.
blessings.other: Though {name} is pressed on every side, may {name} not be crushed; though perplexed, may {name} not despair. When {name} is struck down, may God hold {name} up and not let the weight destroy {name}.

blessings.self: May the Spirit himself intercede for you when you can’t find the words. When you don’t understand, may you still believe that God is at work in all things for the good of those who love him.
blessings.other: May the Spirit himself intercede for {name} when {name} can’t find the words. When {name} doesn’t understand, may {name} still believe that God is at work in all things for the good of those who love him.

prayers.self: God, it feels like my world is shaking. Thank you that you are my refuge and my strength, a very present help in trouble. Let me hide in you in the middle of the turmoil, and let my heart stop being afraid. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: God, I pray for {name}, who is in trouble. Please be {name}’s refuge and strength, a very present help in all the turmoil, so that {name}’s heart is no longer afraid. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, I am pressed on every side, and it’s so hard. Don’t let me be crushed, and don’t let me despair. Even if I’m struck down, please hold me up, and let me know you have not abandoned me. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. {name} is pressed on every side and struggling. Don’t let {name} be crushed or despair; even if {name} is struck down, let {name} know you have not abandoned them. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Father, I’m so tired I can’t even find words to pray. Thank you that your Spirit himself intercedes for me with groanings too deep for words. I don’t understand why, but help me believe you are still in control, working all things together for good. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Father, I pray for {name}. When {name} can’t find the words, may your Spirit himself intercede. When {name} doesn’t understand, help {name} still believe that you are in control. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Faith and doubt
passages: You can come to Jesus even when your faith falls short; he welcomes honesty.
You can honestly ask “How long?” and still choose to trust God’s loving kindness.
Jesus sympathizes with our weakness; you can come to him with boldness.

blessings.self: May the Lord who welcomes imperfect faith hold your doubts himself. May you be able to say honestly, “I believe; help my unbelief,” and be gently caught by him.
blessings.other: May the Lord who welcomes imperfect faith hold {name}’s doubts himself. May {name} be able to say honestly, “I believe; help my unbelief,” and be gently caught by him.

blessings.self: May you be free to honestly ask God “How long?” without being pushed away for asking. In the days when God seems silent, may you still trust in his loving kindness, and one day sing again because he has been good to you.
blessings.other: May {name} be free to honestly ask God “How long?” without being pushed away for asking. In the days when God seems silent, may {name} still trust in his loving kindness, and one day sing again because he has been good to {name}.

blessings.self: May Jesus, the high priest who sympathizes with your weakness, hold your doubts himself. May you draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, receive mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
blessings.other: May Jesus, the high priest who sympathizes with {name}’s weakness, hold {name}’s doubts himself. May {name} draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, receive mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

prayers.self: Lord, I believe; help my unbelief. Sometimes I can’t feel you, and I don’t understand what you are doing. Thank you for still welcoming me when I’m honest. Please show yourself to me and strengthen my faith. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. {name} has many doubts. Thank you for welcoming imperfect faith. Please answer {name} as you answered that father, and show yourself to {name}. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, how long will you forget me? I really don’t understand your silence. But I will still trust in your loving kindness. Please look on me and answer me, and let me one day sing again because you have been good to me. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. In the days when you seem silent, please look on {name} and answer, so that {name} can still trust in your loving kindness and one day sing again because you have been good. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord Jesus, I often doubt, and I worry that it disappoints you. Thank you that you are a high priest who sympathizes with my weakness. I come boldly to the throne of grace; please have mercy on me and be my help in time of need. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord Jesus, I pray for {name}. Thank you that you sympathize with our weakness. Please draw {name} to come boldly to the throne of grace, to receive mercy and find grace to help in time of need. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Feeling low and finding hope
passages: You can admit you are downcast, and still tell your own soul: hope in God.
No darkness is deep enough to hide you from God.
Hope isn’t something you have to squeeze out of yourself; God gives it through the Holy Spirit.

blessings.self: When you are downcast, may you be free to admit it honestly, and still say to your own soul: hope in God. May the God of hope be with you at your lowest, and may there be people beside you who are willing to walk with you.
blessings.other: When {name} is downcast, may {name} be free to admit it honestly, and still say to their own soul: hope in God. May the God of hope be with {name} at the lowest point, and may there be people beside {name} willing to walk along.

blessings.self: May you know that however deep the darkness, God is there. Darkness cannot hide you from him; may his right hand hold you and lead you out, one step at a time.
blessings.other: May {name} know that however deep the darkness, God is there. Darkness cannot hide {name} from him; may his right hand hold {name} and lead {name} out, one step at a time.

blessings.self: May the God of hope, through faith, put joy and peace back into your heart little by little. May the power of the Holy Spirit fill you with hope again, and may there be people beside you who are willing to walk with you.
blessings.other: May the God of hope, through faith, put joy and peace back into {name}’s heart little by little. May the power of the Holy Spirit fill {name} with hope again, and may there be people beside {name} willing to walk along.

prayers.self: God, my heart is so heavy, and I can’t find any energy. I admit I’m downcast, but I will still tell my own soul: hope in God. Please help me with the light of your face, and give me strength to talk to family, friends, a pastor, or a medical professional. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: God, I pray for {name}, who is going through a low time. Please be with {name} in this heaviness, help {name} still hope in you, and let {name} receive the companionship and professional help needed. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, I feel like I’m in a very deep darkness. Thank you for saying that even the darkness can’t hide me from you. Please hold me with your right hand, give me strength to find people who can help me, and lead me out one step at a time. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. {name} feels like they’re in a very deep darkness, but even the darkness can’t hide anyone from you. Please hold {name} with your right hand, and let {name} receive the companionship and professional help needed. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: God of hope, I feel like I’ve run out of hope. Please, through faith, put joy and peace back into my heart little by little, fill me with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit, and give me courage to ask for help from people who can help me. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: God of hope, I pray for {name}. Please put joy and peace back into {name}’s heart little by little, fill {name} with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit, and let {name} receive the companionship and professional help needed. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Self-worth
passages: God made you himself, fearfully and wonderfully.
Eph 2:10
You are God’s workmanship, not something tossed into the world by chance.
Even the hairs of your head are counted; you are very precious in God’s eyes.

blessings.self: May the God who made you help you see yourself through his eyes. You were made by his own hands, fearfully and wonderfully; may your heart know this deeply, and may you stop measuring yourself by comparison.
blessings.other: May the God who made {name} help {name} see themselves through his eyes: made by his own hands, fearfully and wonderfully. May {name}’s heart know this deeply, and may {name} stop measuring themselves by comparison.

blessings.self: May you know that you are God’s workmanship, created in Christ Jesus. You were not tossed into the world by chance; may you walk in the path he has prepared for you and stand firm in his love.
blessings.other: May {name} know that {name} is God’s workmanship, created in Christ Jesus, not tossed into the world by chance. May {name} walk in the path God has prepared and stand firm in his love.

blessings.self: May you know that even the hairs of your head have been counted by your Father, and that you are very precious in his eyes. May you no longer fear that you aren’t good enough, but live at peace in his care.
blessings.other: May {name} know that even the hairs of {name}’s head have been counted by the Father, and that {name} is very precious in his eyes. May {name} no longer fear not being good enough, but live at peace in his care.

prayers.self: God, I often feel I’m not good enough. Thank you for saying that I was made by your own hands, fearfully and wonderfully. Let my heart know this deeply; help me see myself through your eyes and stop measuring myself by comparison. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: God, I pray for {name}. Thank you for making {name} with your own hands, fearfully and wonderfully. Let {name}’s heart know this deeply, see themselves through your eyes, and be free from comparison and self-rejection. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, I often doubt that my life has any meaning. Thank you for saying that I am your workmanship, created in Christ Jesus. Please show me the path you have prepared for me, and help me stand firm in your love. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. Thank you for saying that {name} is your workmanship. Please show {name} the path you have prepared, so that {name} no longer doubts their worth but stands firm in your love. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Father, I often feel I don’t matter. Thank you for counting even the hairs of my head, and for saying I am worth more than many sparrows. Please take away the fear in my heart, and let me live at peace in your care. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Father, I pray for {name}. Thank you for counting even the hairs of {name}’s head; {name} is very precious in your eyes. Please take away the fear in {name}’s heart, and let {name} live at peace in your care. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: School and exams
passages: Prov 16:3
Prepare as well as you can, and entrust the results to God.
Ask God to establish the work of your hands, including all your effort these days.
Phil 4:6-7
When you’re nervous, you can tell God about the pressure and ask his peace to guard your heart.

blessings.self: May you commit everything you do and prepare to the Lord. After you have done your best, may you rest in leaving the results to him, because your worth is not decided by a score.
blessings.other: May {name} commit everything {name} does and prepares to the Lord. After doing their best, may {name} rest in leaving the results to him, because {name}’s worth is not decided by a score.

blessings.self: May the favor of the Lord our God be on you. May he establish the work of your hands, so your effort these days is not wasted, and may you remember what you have learned and express it clearly.
blessings.other: May the favor of the Lord our God be on {name}. May he establish the work of {name}’s hands, so the effort these days is not wasted, and may {name} remember what {name} has learned and express it clearly.

blessings.self: When you are nervous, may you tell God about each pressure, one by one. May God’s peace, which surpasses all understanding, guard your heart and your thoughts, so that you are at peace in the exam room.
blessings.other: When {name} is nervous, may {name} tell God about each pressure, one by one. May God’s peace, which surpasses all understanding, guard {name}’s heart and thoughts, so that {name} is at peace in the exam room.

prayers.self: Lord, the exam is getting closer and I’m nervous. I want to prepare as well as I can, and I entrust the results to you. Please help me remember what I’ve learned and express it clearly, and help me remember that my worth isn’t decided by a score. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}, who is preparing for an exam. Help {name} prepare well and entrust the results to you; help {name} remember what {name} has learned, express it clearly, and have peace. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord our God, let your favor be on me. I’ve worked hard these days; please establish the work of my hands, don’t let my preparation be wasted, and give me the physical and mental strength to make it to the end. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord our God, I pray for {name}. Let your favor be on {name}; establish the work of {name}’s hands, don’t let this time of preparation be wasted, and give {name} physical and mental strength. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Father, I’m nervous and under a lot of pressure. I’m telling you each of these worries now, one by one, and thanking you for leading me this far. Please guard my heart with your peace that surpasses all understanding, and let me do my best calmly in the exam. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Father, I pray for {name}. You know how nervous and pressured {name} feels. Please guard {name}’s heart with your peace that surpasses all understanding, and let {name} do their best calmly in the exam. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Temptation and addiction
passages: God is faithful; he will make a way of escape for you.
Jesus sympathizes with your weakness; even when you fall, you can come back to him with boldness.
Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you.

blessings.self: May the faithful God make a way of escape for you in every temptation, so that you are able to endure it. May you know that nothing you face is beyond what he knows or what he can help with.
blessings.other: May the faithful God make a way of escape for {name} in every temptation, so that {name} is able to endure it. May {name} know that nothing {name} faces is beyond what he knows or what he can help with.

blessings.self: May Jesus, the high priest who sympathizes with your weakness, keep you from being crushed by shame. When you fall, may you still come back boldly, again and again, to the throne of grace, and receive mercy and help in time of need.
blessings.other: May Jesus, the high priest who sympathizes with {name}’s weakness, keep {name} from being crushed by shame. When {name} falls, may {name} still come back boldly, again and again, to the throne of grace, and receive mercy and help in time of need.

blessings.self: May you submit to God and resist temptation, and as you draw near to God, may you find that he draws near to you. May he cleanse your hands and purify your heart, and bring you companions for the journey.
blessings.other: May {name} submit to God and resist temptation, and as {name} draws near to God, may {name} find that he draws near too. May he cleanse {name}’s hands and purify {name}’s heart, and bring companions for the journey.

prayers.self: Lord, I’m struggling in the same place again, and I’m ashamed. Thank you that you are faithful and will not let me be tempted beyond what I can bear. When temptation comes, please make a way of escape for me, and give me courage to ask for help from someone I trust. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}, who is struggling. Thank you that you are faithful. When temptation comes, please make a way of escape for {name} so that {name} can endure it, and provide companions for the journey. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord Jesus, I’ve fallen again, and I feel too ashamed to come to you. Thank you that you sympathize with my weakness. I come boldly back to the throne of grace; please have mercy on me, give me help in my time of need, and help me stand up once more. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord Jesus, I pray for {name}. Thank you that you sympathize with our weakness. Don’t let {name} be crushed by shame; draw {name} to come back boldly, again and again, to the throne of grace. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: God, I want to submit to you and resist the things that pull me away from you. Thank you for saying that if I draw near to you, you will draw near to me. Please cleanse my hands and purify my heart, so I am no longer double-minded. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: God, I pray for {name}. Help {name} submit to you and resist temptation, find your nearness as {name} draws near to you, and purify {name}’s heart so {name} is no longer double-minded. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Being wronged and injustice
passages: Commit this matter to God, and wait quietly before him.
Jesus was treated unjustly too; he understands how you’ve been wronged.
You don’t have to take revenge yourself; leave justice to God, and you can also seek help through proper channels.

blessings.self: May you commit this matter to the Lord and wait quietly before him. May he make your righteousness go out as the light and your justice as the noon day sun, and may you not fret because the wicked seem to prosper.
blessings.other: May {name} commit this matter to the Lord and wait quietly before him. May he make {name}’s righteousness go out as the light and {name}’s justice as the noon day sun, and may {name} not fret because the wicked seem to prosper.

blessings.self: May the Lord Jesus, who was treated unjustly himself, understand how you’ve been wronged. Like him, may you entrust yourself to the God who judges righteously, and not be bound by bitterness or thoughts of revenge.
blessings.other: May the Lord Jesus, who was treated unjustly himself, understand how {name} has been wronged. Like him, may {name} entrust themselves to the God who judges righteously, and not be bound by bitterness or thoughts of revenge.

blessings.self: May you leave vengeance in God’s hands instead of taking revenge yourself. May he protect you and bring people who can help you; and may you not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
blessings.other: May {name} leave vengeance in God’s hands instead of taking revenge. May he protect {name} and bring people who can help; and may {name} not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

prayers.self: Lord, I’ve been wronged, and my heart is full of resentment. I commit this matter to you; please make my righteousness shine like the light. Help me wait quietly before you, and not fret because others seem to be getting ahead. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}, who has been wronged. Please see the injustice {name} has suffered, make {name}’s righteousness shine like the light, and help {name} wait quietly before you. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord Jesus, you too were misunderstood and insulted, yet you did not insult in return. You understand how I’ve been wronged. Help me, like you, to entrust myself to the God who judges righteously, and not be bound by bitterness. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord Jesus, I pray for {name}. You too were treated unjustly, and you understand how {name} has been wronged. Help {name} entrust themselves to the God who judges righteously, and not be bound by bitterness. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, I really want to get justice for myself. Help me not take revenge, but leave justice in your hands, and give me wisdom to seek help in proper ways. Keep me from being overcome by evil, and help me overcome evil with good. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. Please protect {name}, help {name} not take revenge but leave justice in your hands, find help through proper channels, and not be overcome by evil. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Growing in faith
passages: John 15:4-5
The secret of growth is to remain in the Lord, like a branch joined to the vine.
Phil 1:6
God has already begun his work in you, and he will complete it.
Be diligent in grace, and grow the fruit of character little by little.

blessings.self: Like a branch joined to the vine, may you remain in the Lord, and may he remain in you. May you bear much fruit in him: the fruit of love, joy, and peace.
blessings.other: Like a branch joined to the vine, may {name} remain in the Lord, and may he remain in {name}. May {name} bear much fruit in him: the fruit of love, joy, and peace.

blessings.self: May the God who began a good work in you complete his work himself. When you feel cold or stuck, may you still believe that he hasn’t given up on you, and that he will finish it.
blessings.other: May the God who began a good work in {name} complete his work himself. When {name} feels cold or stuck, may {name} still believe that he hasn’t given up on {name}, and that he will finish it.

blessings.self: May you be diligent in grace, adding to your faith moral excellence, knowledge, self-control, perseverance, godliness, and love. May you not be idle in knowing the Lord Jesus, and grow the fruit of character little by little.
blessings.other: May {name} be diligent in grace, adding to faith moral excellence, knowledge, self-control, perseverance, godliness, and love. May {name} not be idle in knowing the Lord Jesus, and grow the fruit of character little by little.

prayers.self: Lord Jesus, I long to know you more, but I often feel cold toward you. Help me remain in you, like a branch joined to the vine, because apart from you I can do nothing. Let me bear much fruit in you. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord Jesus, I pray for {name}. Draw {name} to remain in you, like a branch joined to the vine, to meet you in Scripture and in prayer, and to bear much fruit. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Father, my spiritual life feels stuck. Thank you for saying that he who began a good work in me will complete it. Please don’t give up on me; keep working in me until the day of Jesus Christ. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Father, I pray for {name}. Thank you for beginning a good work in {name}; you will complete it. When {name} feels stuck or cold, please keep working within. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, I want to be diligent in your grace. Help me add to my faith moral excellence, knowledge, self-control, perseverance, godliness, and love, so that I am neither idle nor unfruitful in knowing you. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. Help {name} be diligent in grace, adding to faith moral excellence, knowledge, self-control, perseverance, godliness, and love, and grow the fruit of character little by little. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Serving and ministry
passages: Your labor in the Lord is not in vain.
Don’t lose heart; the harvest comes in God’s time.
Serve with the gifts God has given you; the strength comes from him too.

blessings.self: May you be steadfast and immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work. May you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain, and that he remembers everything you have given, seen and unseen.
blessings.other: May {name} be steadfast and immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work. May {name} know that labor in the Lord is not in vain, and that he remembers everything given, seen and unseen.

blessings.self: May you not grow weary in doing good, and not lose heart when you are tired. May the Lord renew your passion, and in his time let you see the harvest.
