blessings.other: May {name} not grow weary in doing good, and not lose heart when tired. May the Lord renew {name}’s passion, and in his time let {name} see the harvest.

blessings.self: May you serve with the gift God has given you, as a good steward of his many kinds of grace. May you serve in the strength God supplies, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ.
blessings.other: May {name} serve with the gift God has given, as a good steward of his many kinds of grace. May {name} serve in the strength God supplies, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ.

prayers.self: Lord, serving is exhausting, and sometimes I can’t see any results. Thank you for saying that my labor in you is not in vain. Please make me steadfast and immovable, renew my passion, and let me keep abounding in your work. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name} as {name} serves. Please remind {name} that labor in you is not in vain, make {name} steadfast, renew {name}’s passion, and remember everything given that no one sees. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, I’m starting to lose heart in doing good. Please keep me from giving up, and help me believe that in due season we will reap. Renew my strength, and when I have the opportunity, let me still be willing to do good to others. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. Keep {name} from growing weary in doing good or losing heart; help {name} believe that in your time there will be a harvest, and renew {name}’s strength. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, thank you for giving me gifts so that I can serve. Help me be a good steward of your many kinds of grace, and serve in the strength you supply, not my own, so that you are glorified in all things. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. Thank you for the gifts you’ve given {name}. Help {name} serve in the strength you supply, be a good steward of your gifts, and bring you glory in all things. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Humility and envy
passages: Phil 2:3-5
Have the mind of Christ, and count others better than yourself.
Focus on examining your own path; you don’t have to live in comparison with others.
Humble yourself under God’s mighty hand; he will lift you up at the right time.

blessings.self: May the Lord who emptied himself put his mind in you. May you be humble in heart, count others better than yourself, and genuinely look out for the interests of others.
blessings.other: May the Lord who emptied himself put his mind in {name}. May {name} be humble in heart, count others better than themselves, and genuinely look out for the interests of others.

blessings.self: May you be set free from comparison and focus on examining your own path. May you faithfully carry the load God has given you, and genuinely rejoice in other people’s blessings.
blessings.other: May {name} be set free from comparison and focus on examining their own path. May {name} faithfully carry the load God has given, and genuinely rejoice in other people’s blessings.

blessings.self: May you clothe yourself with humility and wait in peace under God’s mighty hand. May the God who gives grace to the humble lift you up at the right time.
blessings.other: May {name} be clothed with humility and wait in peace under God’s mighty hand. May the God who gives grace to the humble lift {name} up at the right time.

prayers.self: Lord Jesus, I admit I often want to win and be noticed. Please put your mind in me; make me humble in heart, help me count others better than myself, and be willing to look out for the interests of others. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord Jesus, I pray for {name}. Please put your mind in {name}; make {name} humble in heart, count others better than themselves, and look out for the interests of others. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, I often compare myself with others, and envy and resentment fill my heart. Help me focus on examining my own path, faithfully carry the load you’ve given me, and genuinely rejoice in other people’s blessings. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. Set {name} free from comparison to focus on examining their own path, faithfully carry the load you’ve given, and genuinely rejoice for others. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: God, please forgive the pride in my heart. I want to clothe myself with humility and humble myself under your mighty hand. Thank you that you give grace to the humble; please lift me up at the right time. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: God, I pray for {name}. Help {name} be clothed with humility and humble themselves under your mighty hand. Thank you that you give grace to the humble; please lift {name} up at the right time. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Thanksgiving and celebration
passages: May the Lord bless you, keep you, and make his face shine on you.
Count all of God’s benefits, and don’t forget a single one.
In every season, always rejoice, pray without ceasing, and give thanks in everything.

blessings.self: May the Lord bless you and keep you. May the Lord make his face to shine on you and be gracious to you. May the Lord lift up his face toward you and give you peace.
blessings.other: May the Lord bless {name} and keep {name}. May the Lord make his face to shine on {name} and be gracious. May the Lord lift up his face toward {name} and give peace.

blessings.self: In this moment worth remembering, may you count all of God’s benefits and not forget a single one. May he crown you with loving kindness and tender mercies, and satisfy your desire with good things.
blessings.other: In this moment worth remembering, may {name} count all of God’s benefits and not forget a single one. May he crown {name} with loving kindness and tender mercies, and satisfy {name}’s desire with good things.

blessings.self: May you always rejoice, pray without ceasing, and give thanks in everything. In this season, may you know God’s good purpose and thank him with a heart full of joy.
blessings.other: May {name} always rejoice, pray without ceasing, and give thanks in everything. In this season, may {name} know God’s good purpose and thank him with a heart full of joy.

prayers.self: Father, thank you for blessing me in this moment worth remembering. Please keep protecting me, make your face shine on me, lift up your face toward me, and give me peace. I bring this joy to you and thank you. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Father, I give you thanks for {name}. Please bless {name} and keep {name}; make your face shine on {name}, lift up your face toward {name}, and give peace. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Bless the Lord, my soul! Lord, I will count all your benefits and not forget a single one. Thank you for forgiving, healing, and redeeming me, and for crowning me with loving kindness and tender mercies. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I bless you for {name}. Thank you for every benefit you have given {name}, crowning {name} with loving kindness and tender mercies. Help {name} count your grace and not forget a single one. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Father, thank you for this joy. Help me always rejoice, pray without ceasing, and give thanks in everything; not only in the good moments, but also remembering to thank you on ordinary days. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Father, I thank you for {name}. Help {name} always rejoice, pray without ceasing, and give thanks in everything, knowing your good purpose in every season. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Peace
passages: John 14:27
The peace Jesus leaves is different from what the world gives.
Those whose minds stay on God, God keeps in perfect peace.
Ps 4:8
Because God watches over you, you can lie down and sleep in peace tonight.

blessings.self: May the Lord Jesus himself give you his peace, a peace not like the world gives. May your heart no longer be troubled or afraid.
blessings.other: May the Lord Jesus himself give {name} his peace, a peace not like the world gives. May {name}’s heart no longer be troubled or afraid.

blessings.self: May your mind stay on God, and may he keep you in perfect peace. May your heart grow quiet, trusting in the Lord, the everlasting Rock.
blessings.other: May {name}’s mind stay on God, and may he keep {name} in perfect peace. May {name}’s heart grow quiet, trusting in the Lord, the everlasting Rock.

blessings.self: May you lie down and sleep in peace tonight, for the Lord alone makes you live in safety. May he watch over your night and let you wake up renewed.
blessings.other: May {name} lie down and sleep in peace tonight, for the Lord alone makes us live in safety. May he watch over {name}’s night and let {name} wake up renewed.

prayers.self: Lord Jesus, my heart is in turmoil and I can’t settle down. Thank you for leaving me your peace, which is not like what the world gives. Please give me your peace, so my heart is no longer troubled or afraid. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord Jesus, I pray for {name}. Please give {name} your peace, which is not like what the world gives, so that {name}’s heart is no longer troubled or afraid. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, my heart is often pulled away by all kinds of things. Help me keep my mind steadily on you, because you are the everlasting Rock. Please keep me in perfect peace. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. Help {name} keep their mind steadily on you, the everlasting Rock, and keep {name} in perfect peace. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, it’s hard to fall asleep tonight, and my mind won’t stop. I give you everything from today. Please let me lie down and sleep in peace, for you alone make me live in safety. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. Please let {name} lie down and sleep in peace tonight, for you alone make us live in safety, and watch over {name}’s night. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Sleeplessness
passages: You can close your eyes in peace, because the God who keeps you stays awake all night.
When you can’t sleep, you don’t have to be angry with yourself; you can meditate on God in bed and rest in the shadow of his wings.
Even if worries remain, you can hand them to God first, and then lie down.

blessings.self: May the God who keeps you watch over you all night. In the dark, may you know you are not the only one awake, and may you hand the night watch to the One who never slumbers, and close your eyes in peace.
blessings.other: May the God who keeps {name} watch over {name} all night. In the dark, may {name} know they are not the only one awake, hand the night watch to the One who never slumbers, and close their eyes in peace.

blessings.self: On sleepless nights, may you not be swept away by restlessness and self-blame, but remember how God has helped you before. In the shadow of his wings, may your body and your heart find rest.
blessings.other: On sleepless nights, may {name} not be swept away by restlessness and self-blame, but remember how God has helped before. In the shadow of his wings, may {name}’s body and heart find rest.

blessings.self: May the God who is a shield around you catch every worry you bring to bed. May you lie down and sleep, and wake up still sustained by him.
blessings.other: May the God who is a shield around {name} catch every worry {name} brings to bed. May {name} lie down and sleep, and wake up still sustained by him.

prayers.self: Father, it’s late and I still can’t sleep; my mind won’t stop. Thank you that you who keep me will not slumber or sleep. I hand tonight’s watch to you; please let my body and mind slowly relax. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Father, I pray for {name}. {name} often can’t sleep at night lately. Please, God who never slumbers, watch over {name}, let {name}’s body and mind slowly relax, and give real rest. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, I keep tossing and turning in bed, and the more I think, the more awake I get. Help me not be angry with myself, but remember you in this moment, recall how you have helped me, and rest in the shadow of your wings. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. On sleepless nights, help {name} not be angry with themselves, but remember how you have helped before, and rest in the shadow of your wings. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, you are a shield around me. I give you each thing weighing on my heart, one by one. Please let me lie down and sleep, wake up still sustained by you, and give me strength to face tomorrow. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, please be a shield around {name}. {name} has gone to bed carrying many worries; please catch them, let {name} lie down and sleep, and wake up still sustained by you. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Getting to know the gospel
passages: God loves the world; he sent Jesus not to condemn, but to save.
Salvation is God’s free gift of grace, not something earned by how well you perform.
Anyone in Christ is a new creation.

blessings.self: May the God who loves the world let you know deeply that he loves you too. May you understand that he sent Jesus not to condemn you, but to save you, so that through faith you may have eternal life.
blessings.other: May the God who loves the world let {name} know deeply that he loves {name} too. May {name} understand that God sent Jesus not to condemn, but to save, so that through faith we may have eternal life.

blessings.self: May you understand that salvation is by grace through faith, freely given by God, not earned by how well you perform. May you find rest in this grace.
blessings.other: May {name} understand that salvation is by grace through faith, freely given by God, not earned by how well we perform. May {name} find rest in this grace.

blessings.self: May you experience new life in Christ: the old things have passed away, and all things have become new. May this new life show itself in you more and more each day.
blessings.other: May {name} experience new life in Christ: the old things have passed away, and all things have become new. May this new life show itself in {name} more and more each day.

prayers.self: God, I want to know you. Thank you for loving the world so much that you gave your only Son for us; you sent Jesus not to condemn me, but to save me. Please help me believe and receive eternal life. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: God, I pray for {name}. Thank you for loving the world and sending Jesus not to condemn, but to save. Please let {name} know your love, believe, and receive eternal life. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: God, I often think I have to be good enough to be accepted by you. Thank you for saying that salvation is by grace through faith, freely given by you. Please help me receive this grace and find rest in you. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: God, I pray for {name}. Let {name} understand that salvation is by grace through faith, freely given by you, not earned by performance, and let {name} find rest in you. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord Jesus, I want to start over. Thank you for saying that if anyone is in you, they are a new creation. Please make me a new creation, and lead me to people and a church who will read the Bible with me. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord Jesus, I pray for {name}. Thank you that you make those who are in you a new creation. Let {name} experience that the old has passed away and all things have become new, and provide the right people and church for {name}. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Facing death and the end of life
passages: Even as you walk through the valley of the shadow of death, the Lord is with you.
John 14:1-3
Jesus has already prepared a place for those who are his.
Neither death nor life can separate us from the love of God.

blessings.self: May the good shepherd walk with you through this valley, and may his rod and his staff comfort you. May goodness and loving kindness follow you all the days of your life, until you dwell in the Lord’s house.
blessings.other: May the good shepherd walk with {name} through this valley, and may his rod and staff bring comfort. May goodness and loving kindness follow {name} all the days of {name}’s life, until {name} dwells in the Lord’s house.

blessings.self: May your heart not be troubled, because Jesus has already prepared a place in his Father’s house for those who are his. May his promise give you and the family you love peace in these days.
blessings.other: May {name}’s heart not be troubled, because Jesus has already prepared a place in his Father’s house for those who are his. May his promise give {name} and the family {name} loves peace in these days.

blessings.self: May you know deeply that neither death nor life can separate you from the love of God in Christ Jesus. May this love surround you, and surround the family you love.
blessings.other: May {name} know deeply that neither death nor life can separate us from the love of God in Christ Jesus. May this love surround {name}, and surround the family {name} loves.

prayers.self: Good shepherd, I am walking through the valley of the shadow of death. Thank you for being with me; your rod and your staff comfort me. Please ease my body’s pain, give me peace, and let me and my family say “I love you,” “thank you,” and “goodbye” well. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Good shepherd, I pray for {name}, who is walking the last part of the road. In the valley of the shadow of death, please be with {name}, ease the pain, and let the family say “I love you,” “thank you,” and “goodbye” well. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord Jesus, you said, “Don’t let your heart be troubled.” Thank you for preparing a place in your Father’s house for those who are yours. Please take away the fear in my heart, and give me and my family peace to spend the remaining days well. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord Jesus, I pray for {name}. Thank you for preparing a place in your Father’s house for those who are yours. Please take away the sorrow and fear in {name}’s heart, and give the family peace to spend these days well. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Father, facing death, my heart is full of things I’m not ready to let go of. Thank you for saying that neither death nor life can separate us from your love in Christ Jesus. Please surround me and the family I love with this love. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Father, I pray for {name}. Thank you for saying that neither death nor life can separate us from your love in Christ Jesus. Please surround {name} and the family {name} loves with this love. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

name: Refuge in danger
passages: God is a high tower for the oppressed; he has heard your cry.
God is near the brokenhearted; seeking real protection is also part of his care.
You can pour out your heart before God; he is your refuge.

blessings.self: May the God who is a high tower for the oppressed keep you safe right now. The harm done to you is not your fault; may he not forsake you as you seek him, and may he bring you to a safe place.
blessings.other: May the God who is a high tower for the oppressed keep {name} safe right now. The harm done to {name} is not {name}’s fault; may he not forsake those who seek him, and may he bring {name} to a safe place.

blessings.self: May the Lord hear your cry and deliver you out of trouble. May he come near to your wounded heart, and bring you people you can trust who can actually help you.
blessings.other: May the Lord hear {name}’s cry and deliver {name} out of trouble. May he come near to that wounded heart, and bring people {name} can trust who can actually help.

blessings.self: May you be free to pour out your heart before God; he is your refuge and your high tower. May he be the rock of your strength, and lead you to real protection and help.
blessings.other: May {name} be free to pour out their heart before God, for he is a refuge and a high tower. May he be the rock of {name}’s strength, and lead {name} to real protection and help.

prayers.self: Lord, I’m scared and I feel helpless. Thank you that you are a high tower for the oppressed and never forsake those who seek you. Please keep me safe, give me courage to reach out to a helpline, someone I trust, or the police, and open a safe way for me. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}, who is in danger. Thank you that you are a high tower for the oppressed. Please keep {name} safe, give {name} courage to reach out to people who can help, and show me how to help in practical ways. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: Lord, please hear my cry and deliver me from this trouble. Thank you for being near to the brokenhearted. Please protect me, and give me courage to reach out to a helpline, someone I trust, or the police, so I can get real protection. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: Lord, I pray for {name}. Please hear {name}’s cry, deliver {name} from trouble, and help {name} reach out to people who can help and get real protection. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

prayers.self: God, I pour out my heart before you. You are my rock, my salvation, and my refuge. Please keep me safe, give me strength to reach out to a helpline, someone I trust, or the police, and bring me to a safe place. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
prayers.other: God, I pray for {name}. Please be {name}’s refuge and high tower, keep {name} safe, give {name} courage to reach out to people who can help, and show me how to help in practical ways. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
